analysis:
The supplied files contain only a documentation-only CHANGELOG.md patch (+5 lines, lines 1-9 in the head). It adds an 'Unreleased — coordinator schema migrations' entry describing a move to numbered goose migrations: a baseline version 1, a 3-second lock timeout with up to 3 retries, an advisory lock for concurrently starting coordinators, and a checked-in schema.sql with a test that migrations build that schema. The CHANGELOG diff alone changes no executable code or runtime security behavior.

The actual migration code, schema files and tests were not supplied, so those changes were not reviewed. Coverage is limited to the changelog text.

Relevant threat-model touchpoints to examine if the code is supplied: A-009 payment ledger and A-015/A-016/A-017 App Attest and build qualification tables, where schema integrity and migration correctness matter. Also the fail-closed startup behaviors noted in the existing changelog: retired backfill markers, and a boot refusal if `usage.cached_tokens` or `model_prices.cache_read_price` cannot be added. The migration change replaces those inline DDL paths, so confirm that its baseline-recording step preserves them and does not silently skip required constraints, unique indexes or revocation-table row-lock semantics. Also confirm that advisory-lock and timeout retry failures fail closed and do not start the coordinator against a partially migrated schema.

I found no concrete security regression from the changelog text. Review of the migration code itself is still needed, so I set needs_deeper_review to true.
